youtube.baslik: How did tinnitus retraining therapy, or TRT, compare with placebo? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: In 2019, a US placebo-controlled multicenter trial compared full TRT, counseling with a placebo sound generator, and standard care; questionnaires measuring tinnitus impact showed no significant difference between the three groups, and many participants improved in each group. These results suggest that counseling and regular follow-up carry an important share of the improvement.
